passive.name: Scalemail
passive.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

spells.name: Emberstrike
spells.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana's Attacks deal {{ calc_max_health_damage }} max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit and reduce this Ability's Cooldown by {{ cooldown_reduction }} seconds.

Active: Shyvana's next Attack strikes the target and the surrounding area dealing {{ calc_damage }} physical damage. This Ability may be Recast after an Attack or short delay within the next {{ recastduration }} seconds.

Dragon Form: Shyvana gains an additional Recast, causing her to bite the target of her next Attack dealing {{ calc_dragon_form_damage }} true damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Inferno Aegis
spells.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana wraps herself in flames for {{ duration }} seconds, gaining {{ calc_shield }} Shield, increased by {{ calc_shield_per_nearby_champion }} per nearby enemy champion and {{ movespeed }} Move Speed, increased to {{ movespeedtowardsenemies }} when moving towards enemy champions.

When the effect ends, the Shield is broken, or upon Recast the area around her detonates, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage.

Dragon Form: If the detonation hits an enemy champion Shyvana heals for {{ calc_base_heal }} + {{ calc_missing_health_heal }} Missing Health.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Molten Burst
spells.description: Shyvana launches a fireball that explodes upon striking a large target and slows them. In Dragon Form, it passes through and explodes upon striking large enemies, leaving behind a trail of fire.
spells.tooltip:
Shyvana launches a fireball at the target location dealing {{ damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_damage }} Max health magic damage and Slowing by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. It explodes upon striking an enemy or reaching its terminus.

Dragon Form: Shyvana's fireball is larger and pierces through enemies. Upon striking a champion, large monster, or reaching its terminus it triggers a pulse of fire that deals {{ calc_dragon_damage }} + {{ calc_max_health_dragon_damage }} Max Health magic damage and Slows by {{ calc_slow_dragon }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds. The fireball leaves behind a trail for {{ groundlingerduration }} seconds that deals {{ damagepersecond }} magic damage per second. {{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Dragon's Descent
spells.description: Shyvana transforms into a Dragon and leaps forward causing enemies along her path to flee. While in Dragon form she becomes larger and her basic abilities are empowered.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Shyvana generates {{ fury_generation }} Dragon Fury by striking enemies with Attacks and Abilities, increased by {{ tt_fury_mult }} while in Dragon Form, and reduced {{ tt_fury_aoe_penalty }} by when striking in an area against non-champions.

Active: Shyvana transforms into her Dragon Form, becoming Unstoppable, and flying to the target location breathing fire on enemies below dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and causing them Flee for {{ fearduration }} seconds.

While transformed, Shyvana's basic Abilities are upgraded, she gains {{ calc_bonus_health }} bonus Health, size, and Attack Range. Shyvana loses Dragon Fury over time and her transformation ends when she has no Dragon Fury remaining.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Fury of the Dragonborn
effects: Innate: Shyvana gains 5 bonus armor and 5 bonus magic resistance, which are each increased by 5 for every elemental drake and Elder Dragon her team slays.
Additionally, Shyvana deals 20% increased damage to Dragons.

variants.name: Twin Bite
effects: Basic attacks reduce Twin Bite's current cooldown by 0.5 seconds on-hit.

Dragon Form Bonus: Shyvana attacks enemies in a cone in front of her and additionally applies the second strike to enemies surrounding the primary target. Both the attack and the strike occur at the same time and each of them apply Twin Bite's respective effects to all targets hit, with the exception of the second strike not triggering on-attack effects for secondary targets struck. The attack is affected by critical strike modifiers, applies on-hit effects to all enemies hit, and triggers on-attack effects for every target hit. Additionally, Twin Bite's empowered attack has an uncancellable windup.
Twin Bite resets Shyvana's basic attack timer.

variants.name: Burnout
effects: Dragon Form Bonus: Burnout's radius increases, scaling with Dragon's Descent's rank.

variants.name: Flame Breath
effects: Shyvana's basic attacks against marked enemies are empowered to deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to 3% (+ 1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health, capped at 150 against monsters.
